sources.note: Inserts a stage before RL in which the model extracts textual lessons from its own successful and failed rollouts, filters them by measured marginal utility on a held-out probe set, and distills the surviving pool into its own weights — so that GRPO starts from a policy that fails all-eight-samples less often.
sources.title: Self-Improving Large Language Models via Progressive Experience Evolution

sources.note: Builds prefix trees of semantically equivalent reasoning statements and measures how RLVR changes a model's preference between branches, finding the entropy collapse is not stylistic — the collapse is stronger for semantically distinct continuations than for syntactic variants of the same statement.
sources.title: BODHI: Do LLMs Branch Out and Discover Heterogeneous Inferences?

sources.note: Treats a transformer forward pass as a controlled dynamical system with depth as time, lifts it with the Koopman operator to get a finite linear realisation whose spectrum is coordinate-free, proves that spectrum is recoverable from finite calibration data at the parametric rate, and then proves that the identifiable object and the human-legible object cannot be the same object.
sources.title: Intrinsic Structure: Spectral Identifiability for Mechanistic Interpretability

result.definition: The 8B Qwen3 base checkpoint, used across 3 sources as the largest rung of a base-model ladder in training studies and as an interpretability subject. Its archived appearances: the top scale in a self-improvement study whose stage-one intervention cuts all-eight-wrong prompts by 2.75 points there against 4.95 at 4B; one of four model families in the branch-preference measurement showing entropy collapse concentrated in semantic rather than syntactic contrasts; and a subject in spectral identifiability work. It is also one of the models where fine-tuning on heavily hedged traces improves competition accuracy by up to 2.6-fold.
